headline: RAB detains 6 suspects including 'top criminal' Excel Babu in Adabor attack
summary: The arrests follow a violent robbery of an MFS agent and a subsequent attack on police officers during a raid in Dhaka's Adabor.
details: The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested six people, including Farid Ahmed Babu, alias Excel Babu, described as a 'top criminal' in Mohammadpur.
The suspects were caught during drives in Mohammadpur and Mirpur's Pirerbagh. RAB recovered a motorcycle and a katana from their possession.
The arrests follow a violent sequence that began Tuesday morning when muggers hacked an MFS agent in Adabor and robbed them of money.
Later that afternoon, when police conducted a raid to catch the suspects, the criminals attacked the Adabor Police chief and a sub-inspector with sharp cleavers.
Police responded in self-defence, opening fire and injuring two suspects at the scene. Four individuals were detained immediately during the raid.
With the latest RAB operation, the total number of people detained in connection with the incidents has risen to 10.
caption:
A 'top criminal' and five others were arrested after a violent spree in Adabor that targeted both a civilian and police officers.

The Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) has arrested six people, including Farid Ahmed Babu, alias Excel Babu, described as a 'top criminal' in Mohammadpur.

The suspects were caught during drives in Mohammadpur and Mirpur's Pirerbagh. RAB recovered a motorcycle and a katana from their possession.

The arrests follow a violent sequence that began Tuesday morning when muggers hacked an MFS agent in Adabor and robbed them of money.

Later that afternoon, when police conducted a raid to catch the suspects, the criminals attacked the Adabor Police chief and a sub-inspector with sharp cleavers.

Police responded in self-defence, opening fire and injuring two suspects at the scene. Four individuals were detained immediately during the raid.

With the latest RAB operation, the total number of people detained in connection with the incidents has risen to 10.

headline: 18 Bangladeshis died in the Mediterranean, suspected trafficker arrested
summary: Authorities have arrested a suspected human trafficker following the tragic death of 18 Bangladeshi nationals in the Mediterranean Sea.
details: 18 Bangladeshi nationals have died in the Mediterranean Sea, marking another tragedy in the perilous journey of irregular migration.
Following the incident, law enforcement agencies have arrested a suspected human trafficker involved in the case.
The victims were reportedly attempting to cross the Mediterranean to reach safer shores, a route known for its high risk and death toll.
Investigations are ongoing to determine the exact circumstances of the Mediterranean crossing and the role of the suspect in the organization of the trip.
